result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by narrow, poorly maintained sidewalks and a lack of formal crossing infrastructure. The street lacks lane markings and traffic calming, while large trees and utility poles create visual and physical obstructions for walkers.

hazards.name: Obstructed and narrow sidewalk
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the narrow paved walkway on the right, forcing pedestrians to maneuver around them or step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side sidewalk

hazards.name: Unpaved and debris-filled walkway
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, consisting instead of dirt and debris, which is inaccessible for many users.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or curb ramps are visible at the approaching intersection, making it difficult for pedestrians to cross safely.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the background

interventions.title: Comprehensive Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Pave and widen the walkways on both sides to meet ADA standards and provide a clear path of travel.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim overhanging tree branches to improve sightlines and street lighting effectiveness.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by the lack of a dedicated, separated walkway. Parked vehicles occupy the entire paved area adjacent to buildings, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway without any physical protection or clear path.

hazards.name: Obstruction of Pedestrian Path
hazards.description: Parked vehicles completely block the area where a sidewalk should be, forcing pedestrians into the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground along the left side of the street

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Separation
hazards.description: There is no curb or vertical separation between the vehicle travel area and the space used by pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire street edge visible in the foreground

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The paved surface is cracked and uneven, creating trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Ground surface around the parked blue car

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a raised, ADA-compliant sidewalk with a curb to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Parking Management
interventions.description: Formalize on-street parking with markings and restrictions to ensure the pedestrian walkway remains clear.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Lighting
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a buffer and improve the environment, along with upgraded lighting for better visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by narrow, poorly maintained sidewalks that lack any buffer from the roadway. Pedestrian space is significantly constrained by utility poles placed directly in the walkway, and the presence of a large blank wall on one side reduces passive surveillance.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located in the center of the narrow sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to step into the roadway to pass.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the sidewalk

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway and sidewalk surfaces are cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and midground road surface

hazards.name: Lack of Passive Surveillance
hazards.description: A large blank wall on the left side of the street creates a dead zone with no eyes on the street, potentially impacting personal security.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and ADA Compliance
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalks to provide a clear walking path that accommodates utility poles without obstructing pedestrian movement.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the sidewalks and roadway to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install additional lighting at a lower height to improve visibility and security for pedestrians, especially near blank frontages.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal separation from the roadway, with a degraded paved area serving as both a walkway and a driveway. The presence of debris, poor pavement quality, and boarded-up frontages creates a neglected and potentially hazardous space for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven surfaces on the paved walkway area create tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground paved area

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian-Vehicle Separation
hazards.description: The absence of a raised curb or physical barrier means pedestrians are not protected from vehicles on the adjacent roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Transition between the paved walkway and the street

hazards.name: Debris and Loose Material
hazards.description: Accumulated dirt and gravel on the walkway surface can cause slips and further degrade the walking experience.
hazards.location_in_image: Base of the boarded-up wall and garage entrance

interventions.title: Install Raised Sidewalk and Curb
interventions.description: Construct a standard raised sidewalk with a vertical curb to provide clear physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility and the sense of security for pedestrians using the walkway at night.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and uneven pavement and clear debris to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.
